lead.headline: The Patriots are in; Addison went instead of the Vikings
lead.deck: The defence hole is filled, but the drop was a receiver back in Week 7, not the defence on bye. This week's lineup needs nothing.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Wednesday's add was made at 22:38 UTC, and the drop was Jordan Addison, not the Vikings' defence. Addison's hamstring had him lined up for Week 7, the week Allen, Tuten and McLaurin are all on bye; the Vikings now sit on the bench as a second defence with no use. Next Tuesday's quarterback add for Allen's bye will cost the Vikings instead. The rest is in order. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.1 against Bok-aneers' 89.6, and no starter carries a tag. Rico Dowdle is expected back in Pittsburgh as Warren's backup, and Adonai Mitchell may return for the Jets, which trims Wilson's share; both were reported on Monday and are in the projections. Monangai is still in a boot with no Week 6 practice found. Washington file their first report today.
